character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every shot: electric-blue hair in a sharp shoulder-length cut, bright violet eyes, with a recognizable consistent face and adult body proportions. They are a touring keyboardist who transforms emotion into live stage performances. Fixed costume: a black performance jacket with cobalt panels, fitted stage trousers, and high-top boots. Signature tool or keepsake: a custom synthesizer keycap worn as a pendant. Maintain the exact same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, proportions, costume silhouette, and signature object across the complete music video.
consistency_rules: One clearly defined protagonist leads this theme from beginning to end.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions in every scene.
Preserve the signature outfit, its color identity, and the defining tool or keepsake.
Do not redesign, replace, or multiply the lead character unless the lyrics explicitly require another person.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in concert stage, rehearsal room, backstage corridor; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with electric blue, violet, hot pink, white spotlight; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by wide concert shot, performer close-up, audience point of view; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
